scripts.auth:reset:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "DELETE FROM admin_sessions; DELETE FROM owner_credentials;"
scripts.test: node --test tests/local-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/cloudflare-provision.test.mjs tests/client-secret-check.test.mjs && vitest run && vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts

DB.description: Stores the single owner credential verifier and revocable Admin sessions. Cloudflare provisions this D1 database automatically.

LOGIN_RATE_LIMITER.description: Limits repeated login attempts before password verification.

MCP_OAUTH_RATE_LIMITER.description: Bounds public OAuth registration, token, and authorization requests.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth clients, grants, authorization codes, and hashed token records managed by the Cloudflare OAuth provider.

OWNER_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Temporary high-entropy proof for first-owner setup. Generate at least 32 random bytes encoded as Base64URL, retain it until setup succeeds, and never commit it.
